quantifiers: Every supplied/existing actual broadcaster and every such bank. No covariance, selfadjointness, or positive L2 spectrum required. Traceless factors are used for the H0 witness interface.
inputs: Actual J and factor observables for the explicit construction; compatibility alone suffices for existence.
acquired_output: Product output PVM pulled back through J, then spectral input-effect refinement, with weights eigenvalue/d and exact barycenter I/d.
proof: RESULT.txt section B, Theorem B.1; meter MSE equals twice broadcaster Dirichlet energy and posterior means reduce MSE.
cost: At most d^2 joint PVM outcomes and d^3 refined states; generic dense supplied J has O(d^6) entries. Spectral decomposition, representation and precision are charged.
strongest_control: Exact commuting bank; universal cloner rank-two fixture; N92 supplied-instrument SOS is a different channel/interface.
falsifier: A valid J and such a bank for which the explicitly derived pure-design variance exceeds the exact meter MSE.
unresolved_gate: External proof review and novelty; does not cover a generic bank with three or more incompatible factor groups.
prior_art: No novelty claim. Exact elementary joint-measurement argument reconstructed in this run.
validation: Full mathematical derivation plus exact symbolic qubit fixture and floating d=2,3,4 fixtures; fixtures are not formal verification.

inputs: A PSD Q factored into at most k traceless Hermitian observables and an actual k-output extension.
proof: RESULT.txt B.2-B.3: spectral measure one factor on each output, then rank-one refine the pulled-back input POVM.
cost: At most d^(k+1) states. Supplied dense extension already has exponentially growing size in k; no extension-acquisition procedure claimed.
strongest_control: Rank-one reduces to Kadison contraction; rank-two is a genuine common-design theorem.
falsifier: Exact compatible extension and rank<=k witness with a strict optimized h1 violation.

prior_art: Generic proof obtained here; external novelty remains UNKNOWN.
validation: Internally derived from Theorem B.1; no formal or external validation.

theorem: For every selfadjoint bistochastic actually selfcompatible Phi and every fixed real S subset H0 with dim S<=2, one canonical EB Psi satisfies P_S Psi P_S >= P_S(2Phi-I)P_S. From a supplied J,S an approximate design with slack epsilon is obtained by a finite matrix-multiplicative-weights oracle scheme.
quantifiers: The same Psi serves every observable in S and every family with scores in S. It need not compare the whole H0.
inputs: Exact representable broadcaster J, Phi and an orthonormal tau basis of S; acquisition of these inputs is excluded.
acquired_output: One mixed pure 1-design; T=O(B^2 log dimS / epsilon^2) oracle calls, B=2 for positive Phi and safe B=4 for signed selfadjoint Phi.
proof: RESULT.txt C: finite-dimensional separation from all rank-two witnesses, then the explicit exponential-potential regret derivation.
cost: Each oracle constructs <=d^3 states. A safe naive dense arithmetic cost is O(T d^8), storage O(d^6+T d^4). Exact representability and bit/precision/conditioning costs are additional. Full certified implementation was not run.
physical_consequence: For rho=(I+H)/d with H in S, T(rho,Psi rho)<=0.5 sqrt[2 E_Phi(H)+epsilon tau(H^2)].
strongest_control: N92 already rounds explicitly constructed Petz-square channels; this restricted-score construction starts with the supplied original J.
falsifier: A rank-two separating witness contradicting B, or a correct potential calculation with worse error than charged.
unresolved_gate: Constant c=2 for score dimension >=3 and two receivers; C.2 gives a generic logarithmic factor. Preceding N93 smoothing/reference conversion, external validation and novelty remain separate gates.
validation: Full analytic existence and exact-real arithmetic compiler proof. No uncharged finite-precision or unknown-channel learning claim.

theorem: For every finite d and every selfadjoint bistochastic actually two-output-compatible Phi, and every fixed real S subset H0 of dimension r>=2, there is ONE canonical pure-design EB Psi with P_S(I-Psi)P_S <= 2ceil(log2 r) P_S(I-Phi)P_S. Signed L2 eigenvalues are allowed. On all H0 the exact coefficient is 2ceil(log2(d²-1)).
quantifiers: r is dimension of the common fixed score span S, not the rank of one selected witness. No covariance, positive-spectrum or family-cardinality hypothesis is needed. The r=1 case is fixed exactly by an eigenbasis design.
proof: RESULT C.2: the m-level binary tree has actual 2^m receivers with every marginal Phi^m. The all-rank<=r B.3 measurement lemma plus separation gives ONE comparator against Phi^m. For every lambda in [-1,1], 1-lambda^m <= m(1-lambda), so functional calculus transfers it to Phi.
inputs: Compatibility promise suffices for existence; the finite compiler requires supplied exact representable J, Phi and an orthonormal tau basis of S. Unknown channel, extension or score span acquisition is not proved.
acquired_output: An approximate common pure 1-design with extra epsilon I_S slack via O(B² log r /epsilon²) witness oracle calls; B=2 positive-spectrum or safe B=4 signed-spectrum.
cost: Tree uses 2^m-1<2r primitive two-output calls. After discarding leaves each oracle has <=d^r joint outcomes and <=d^(r+1) refined pure states; safe unoptimized arithmetic O(2^m d^(r+6)+r³) per oracle, storage O(Td^(r+2)+d^6+rd²), plus charged exact representation and precision. Final existence certificate reduces to <=d²+r(r+1)/2 states; reduction acquisition cost remains. No general efficient compiler claimed.
physical_consequence: For valid rho_x=(I+H_x)/d with all H_x in the SAME S, one common Psi obeys trace distance <=0.5sqrt[2ceil(log2 r)E_Phi(H_x)], with epsilon tau(H_x²) added for the approximate compiler. Supplied approximate spans require an explicit uniform L2 tail certificate.
strongest_control: Full-H0 result is O(log d); qubits have the sharper c2 theorem. Bounded capacity alone cannot control this score dimension or tail by C.3.
provenance: Binary-tree Phi^m ingredient already appears in N92 full detailed_balance_broadcast_attack at lines 386-392. New internally reconstructed synthesis is B.3 plus common-design separation and signed scalar energy comparison. No external novelty claim.
closest_checked_primary_source: Brandao-Piani-Horodecki 2015 Theorem 1 gives dimension-dependent additive diamond-norm measure-and-prepare approximation for many receiver marginals, not this exact canonical Dirichlet comparison: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1310.8640
falsifier: A valid actual extension and fixed S with a separating PSD Q contradicting the tree product-PVM variance calculation or signed functional-calculus transfer.
unresolved_gate: Universal c2 remains UNKNOWN; efficient acquisition, noncentral reference reduction, external correctness and novelty remain unproved.
validation: Full analytic proof independently audited by classicality lead; exact symbolic two-level tree fixture. Internal agreement and fixtures are not external/formal validation.

Its explicit four-party Bell-pair state gives an actual bistochastic selfadjoint positive-spectrum compatible Pauli channel with weighted correlation lambda_max(H_q). For these Q, h1 is exactly the unrestricted pure-seed squared-Pauli support because a Pauli orbit has barycenter I/d.

cost: H_q is d^2 by d^2; explicit four-party vector has d^4 components. Eigenprecision and physical representation are charged.
strongest_control: Stabilizer designs give only a lower support bound; general pure seeds may do better.
